verificationLimits: Not tagged and not published in this round: v0.2.0-rc.11 does not exist, so the release workflow tag -> commit -> pin step has not run and the provenance check ran without a tag.
Local toolchain only (node v26.11.1 / npm 11.20.0 / darwin-arm64). The CI matrix (node 22.19.0 and 24.x, linux-x64) and CodeQL were not run here.

docs/evidence/cold-archive-write-path-*.json, retention-plan-*.json and write-path-reconcile-identity-*.json were produced against intermediate candidate builds during the rounds and are not pin evidence; only docs/evidence/dsh-<host>.json is referenced by release/manifest.json and pack:check.

The loader version in the README/RELEASE host table is not part of the recorded evidence; it was re-read from a fresh --keep acceptance install in this round (1.0.5 / 1.0.6-alpha.1) rather than being written into the evidence JSON.
Acceptance assertions cover 21 scripted steps per host; they compare evolution-memory.json by SHA-256 and the presence of event-bridge.key rather than every file under the data root.
